To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the NASA Activity Scale is an excellent tool for measuring physical activity in large population studies.

habitual physical activity is a source of weight loss and weight maintenance and that the relationship of physical activity to weight loss and weight control is dose-dependent and greater for those who weigh more at baseline.

the mean of multiple self-reports of physical activity over a period of time is a significant source for long-term weight change, and that the effect of physical activity on weight loss is greater in individuals who are overweight.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing an equation to predict the amount of physical exercise needed to prevent weight gain in the general population.
developing a mathematical model for predicting the effect of physical activity on long-term weight control.
the role that physical activity plays in weight management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the more active you are, the less you will weigh.
the more physical activity you perform, the less likely you are to gain weight, and the more likely you are to lose weight, and the greater your physical activity level the greater the weight loss.
physical activity is a very important source of long-term (5.5 year) weight change.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the amount of physical exercise needed for long-term (2 y) weight control is dependent on the amount of weight to be lost and the individual’s current level of habitual physical activity.
the more physically active you are the less you weigh and that is a good thing.
physical activity is an important component of weight control, and the greater the amount of activity performed, the more weight that is lost.
The main takeaway from our work is that
people who are overweight should engage in at least 30 minutes of moderately intense exercise on a daily basis to help control their weight.
the more physically active a person is, the less likely that person is to gain weight over time.
the more physically active people are, the more weight they tend to lose over time.
